description: Returns TRF's masked sequence (trf ... -m; TRF README: "every location that occurred in a tandem repeat changed to the letter 'N'"): every position inside a repeat reported by find_approximate_tandem_repeats with the same TRF parameters becomes N, or — with softMask — lower case. Positions outside repeats keep the input characters (TRF itself upper-cases its whole output). Same length as the input. Defaults = TRF recommended 2 7 7 80 10 50 500. apparentSizeTable / apparentSizeTableKind optionally replace the exact apparent-size table (as in find_approximate_tandem_repeats).

sequence.description: Sequence (case-insensitive; any non-A/C/G/T symbol never matches)

maxRepeatLength.description: TRF -l: maximum tandem-repeat length in bp

softMask.description: Lower-case repeat positions instead of writing N

apparentSizeTable.description: Optional apparent-size table y(d) for TRF's apparent-size criterion: 2001 comma/space-separated integers for d = 0..2000 (entry 0 ignored; each y(d) in 0..max(d,20)-1). Empty = the exact table the library computes. TRF 4.10.0's own waitdata80/waitdata75 array (tr30dat.c; AGPL, not shipped) given with apparentSizeTableKind='trfWaitingTimes' reproduces TRF's output bit for bit.

apparentSizeTableKind.description: How apparentSizeTable is expressed: 'apparent' (y(d)) or 'trfWaitingTimes' (TRF waitdata w(d); y = max(d,20) - w - 1)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
TRF parameter out of range (weights >= 1, PM 80/75, PI 1-100, MaxPeriod 1-2000, -l >= 1)
apparentSizeTable must hold 2001 integers, each in 0..max(d,20)-1 (waiting times likewise); apparentSizeTableKind must be 'apparent' or 'trfWaitingTimes'
